_comment: Mesh repo-templating token classifier (Phase 1 pilot). Consumed by render-handlebars.js and referenced by scripts/secret-scan.sh. sed remains the DEFAULT renderer; this governs the opt-in Handlebars path and future repo emission.

allowlist._comment: Git-safe brand-delta tokens that MAY be substituted into an emitted repo. These are tenant-brand identity, never secrets. BRAND/BRAND_TITLE/CLUSTER_DOMAIN/HARBOR_PROJECT are live in templates/apps; 3 are registered-but-currently-dead; HOST_NAME/NPM_SCOPE are the Phase-2 login-ui overlay tokens. GENERATOR_ORG_GROUP was PROMOTED reserved_pilot -> live in Phase 3 now that a 2nd repo (admin-bff-api .gitlab-ci.yml) consumes it. CLUSTER_DOMAIN + BRAND_TITLE are also the admin-bff-api application.yml env-default seams — all ORG/BRAND-derived, none secret-bearing.

denylist._comment: Secret-bearing keys derived from brands/example.conf + brand.conf.example. Rendering/emit MUST refuse to substitute or emit any of these. Exact keys plus a catch-all regex over key NAMES.

frozen_protocol_constants._comment: OUT-OF-SCOPE-FOR-TOKENIZATION. These are wire/label protocol identity, NOT tenant brand. They must stay literal in every emitted repo and must NEVER be turned into {{tokens}} nor rewritten by any renderer. A blind reverse-substitution that rebrands the literal 'snapdragon' would corrupt these. ENFORCED (fail-closed) by token-classifier.isFrozen(): render-handlebars.js refuses any requested/referenced token that lands on one of these — the Phase-3 red-team gate (a brand profile that tries to override e.g. snapdragon.systems/domain is BLOCKED at emit, exit 1).
